info.title: Super Pig (ITA)
info.synopsis: Karin Kokubu (Kassie Carlen nell'adattamento italiano) è una bambina che fa amicizia con un maialino giallo dotato di poteri magici come la capacità di volare e parlare. Il piccolo animaletto si rivela essere nientemeno che Tonrariano III, principe del lontano pianeta a forma di mela Buringo (Oinko nell'adattamento italiano) e dona a Karin uno speciale cofanetto rosa che consente alla bambina di trasformarsi in Tonde Burin (Super Pig nell'adattamento italiano), un maiale rose dotato di superpoteri.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Karin Kokubu rescues a yellow piglet on her way to school. The piglet turns out to be the prince of an alien planet, though, and turns her into the super-pig Buurin- but she'd rather be any other kind of hero.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Karin's school is having an important soccer match with a rival school, one known for their unfair tricks. Koichi, the star player of her school's team, is going to be the victim of these tricks unless Buurin does something about it.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Karin and her best friend Masami have a falling-out during tennis practice. Having a hard time making up, Karin decides to use Buurin to repair their relationship.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: A local park is hosting a female pro-wrestling tournament. Among the wrestlers is an amateur, Buutan, who dresses up like Buurin to fight.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Karin's school's athletic meet is hosting a very special event: a tug-of-war match where all of the first-year students compete with Buurin. Koichi is having trouble organizing the event, though.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: On a history field trip, Karin finds an ancient clay figure that looks a lot like Buurin. It leads her to some ruins that give some insight into Buurin's history.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: A real bank robber interrupts a live show starring Cutey Chao, Karin's favorite heroine. Buurin must stop him quickly.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Karin has been eating a lot lately, but after a comment from Koichi she decides to go on a diet. She goes too far, though, and gets weaker and weaker- this soon starts affecting Buurin's performance as well.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The race circuit that Keiko Kuroha's family owns is hosting a solar car race. Karin and some of her friends enter a Buurin-shaped car in the race, driven by Ms. Tateshi. When the weather takes a turn for the worse, the situation becomes tense.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Shinichiro Kokobu, editor-in-chief of the Akebono Times (and Karin's father), is on the hunt for a big scoop. He has a new target that he's doing some investigative journalism on- Buurin!

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The school's cultural festival includes a 'best couple' contest. Lured in by the promise of a romantic meal for the winning couple, Karin tries to win with Koichi.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi has been really into the supernatural lately, and things are dialed up a notch when a series of coincidences leads him to believe that he has supernatural powers of his own.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: As Karin prepares for a big test, she finds out that Ton has a test as well. If Buurin doesn't collect 50 pearls by the deadline, Ton won't be able to become king of Buuringo.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Koichi's making a movie, and he and the others have a perfect pick for the lead actress: Buurin!

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru, disheartened by littering citizens who won't change their ways, decides to take the task of picking up garbage into her own hands. Buurin ends up helping her.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Karin is looking forward to giving Koichi a gift at a Christmas party. He says he can't come, though. Karin is suspicious- he says the reason is that he has a date with Buurin!

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Karin comes across an opportunity to see if her future is with Koichi.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: There's a big New Years' party at Karin's place! All seems well, but Ton is shut in Karin's room, missing his home planet.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Karin and Koichi get to go (with the rest of their class) to a ski camp. Mr. Arashiyama seems nervous and soon enough Karin finds out he wants to profess his love to Ms. Tateshi.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: There's a cool plant in the school (and it's named after Keiko). Trouble arises when the plant grows out of control and Buurin must defeat it.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Karin faces complicated feelings towards Koichi and wonders who he likes.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: Ton is in love, and not with someone back on his home planet, either.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: It's valentines' day, and. Buurin is helping a local sweets shop to deliver chocolates around town. As orders pile up, she worries she won't even have time to give chocolate to Koichi before the day is over.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Karin's father waits for a natural phenomenon to occur.

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Karin has to choose a doll for Girl's day. She's conflicted about which to choose, though.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Buurin and tennis intersect.

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: Buurin needs to recharge, but has to rescue a puppy and stays transformed for a bit too long, then faces the consequences.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Karin's younger brother has a girlfriend, Hitomi. All is fine until Karin finds out Hitomi has a familiar older brother, one who stood against Koichi's soccer team a while back...

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Keiko funds a class trip to Hawaii.

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: A rumor concerning Buurin is spreading in Hawaii.

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: Nobody seems to want to run for student council president this year... until Keiko Kuroha steps up to the challenge and throws the entire school into election spirit.

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy Matsumoto has a turbulent history with the annual cherry trees.

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: The cold is going through town again, and this time Karin (and by extension, Buurin) gets it. It begins to interfere with Buurin's superheroine activities.

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: Koichi's soccer team faces a big game, but there's some conflict between the players. Mr. Arashiyama says that carp streamers could bring them back together, though.

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: Two ninjas working for Takuma's family kidnap Karin and take her to Kyoto, where her friends shortly follow. Takuma believes that Karin is in love with him.

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: Karin gets to help out with rice planting, but it seems tough.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: Koichi has written a love letter to Buurin. Karin, determined to make Koichi fall in love with her as herself instead, tries to prevent Buurin and Koichi from ever meeting again.

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy sees Buuringo in the sky and, while trying to investigate, falls into another dimension, creating a series of strange circumstances.

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: Everywhere Buurin appears, one strange mark can be found. Karin and Ton head to Kyoto in order to investigate the connection between the mark and the Mushanokoji family.

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: Kashiwagi's grandmother had the chance to become Buurin as well a long time ago.

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: Jimmy's investigations reach their end and he has a theory: Karin and Buurin are the same person! Karin must convince him that he's wrong, somehow.

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: Just as Jimmy is about to confirm his theory, another Buurin appears! This new Buurin is fast, strong, and smart- no one seems to know who she is, and to prove herself as the one real Buurin, the original and the impostor have a showdown.

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: Karin and friends spend a night in the gym basement. Mr. Arashiyama and Karin both have something to hide, so they fake supernatural happenings.

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: Keiko Kuroha has found a strange compact. As it turns out, it's the very same compact that Karin uses to transform into Buurin!

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: Karin finally gets the chance to (temporarily) transform into Cutey Chao! In a strange twist of fate, though, Buurin is needed, and so she has to transform back.

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: Ton and Karin might have to break up their friendship as Karin moves in on her goal of 108 pearls.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: Keiko is having a dinner party at her massive, luxurious mansion. It turns out, though, that her parents only come home once a year.

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: An entrance in a basement leads to another world.

episodes.title: Episodio 49
episodes.synopsis: Monsters from Keiko's mansion have broken into the outside world, and they're attacking the school. Karin can't find time to transform into Buurin and fears she'll have to do it in front of the others, locking her into Buurin form forever.

episodes.title: Episodio 50
episodes.synopsis: Karin decides to reveal she's Buurin and transform to save the city, but doing this will mean she can never transform back into Karin.

episodes.title: Episodio 51
episodes.synopsis: Apparently there need to be 7 Buurins to use the 7 talismans... but there's just one. Karin needs the strength of all of her friends to save the world.
